metaDescription: Get help with deleted files, failing drives, non-booting computers, data transfers, and reliable backups in Ocala, Belleview, and The Villages.

sections.heading: Did You Know?
paragraph: A computer that will not start does not always mean its files are lost.
Clicking sounds, repeated disconnects, and read errors can signal physical drive failure. Continued use can make recovery less likely.
A tested backup is more useful than a backup job that has never been checked.

sections.heading: Who This Helps
paragraph: This service is for homes and small businesses that lost files, cannot access important data, or have a computer or drive that is beginning to fail.
It also helps anyone who stores important photos, records, or business files without a backup they trust.

sections.heading: Signs You May Need Data Recovery or Backup Help
items: Important files were deleted, overwritten, corrupted, or can no longer be opened
A computer will not start, but the files on it are still important
A drive clicks, disconnects, runs unusually slowly, or reports errors
You need to move files safely to a replacement computer or storage device
Your important files do not have a tested backup

sections.heading: What We Do
paragraph: We assess the storage device, recover accessible data when possible, and explain the safest next step.
items: Determine whether software-based recovery is appropriate
Advise when a failing drive should be powered down to prevent further damage
Recover supported deleted, corrupted, or inaccessible files when possible
Transfer accessible data to a replacement computer or storage device
Set up encrypted, automated backups for important files
Use local and offsite backups when the risk and budget support both
Recommend a specialty recovery lab for severe physical damage

sections.heading: When Another Service May Be a Better Fit
paragraph: Choose Data Recovery and Backup Help when saving files, transferring data, or setting up reliable backups is the priority. If the computer itself needs diagnosis or repair, choose [Computer Repair](/services/computer-repair). If the computer works and mainly needs better performance, choose [Laptop and PC Upgrades](/services/pc-upgrades).

sections.heading: Local Availability
paragraph: Data recovery and backup help is available in Ocala, Belleview, The Villages, and nearby Central Florida communities. We explain what may be recoverable, when continued use is risky, and when a specialty lab is the safer choice.

faq.question: Can files be recovered from a computer that will not start?
faq.answer: Often, if the storage device remains readable. We assess the computer and explain the available recovery options before doing the work.

faq.question: Should I keep using a drive that clicks or disconnects?
faq.answer: No. Continued use can cause more damage and reduce the chance of recovery. Turn the device off and have the drive assessed if the files are important.

faq.question: Can you set up backups after recovery?
faq.answer: Yes. We can set up automatic, encrypted backups and show you how to confirm that they are working.
